messages:
sophia-marketing: Quick brief — we need a compact hero + 3 benchmark microtiles for the "Serving Wins" webinar registration and email.
leo-design: Sizes: hero 1200x628, microtiles 600x400 (and stacked mobile 400x600). Exports: PNG@2x, SVG, 600px GIF.
tariq-ux: Workloads confirmed? convo chat, embeddings batch, RAG?
sophia-marketing: Yes. Headline: "Serve smarter, not bigger" Subhead: "Latency-cost benchmarks across common workloads" Include p99 latency and $/1M tokens (anonymized rounded numbers).
jen-product: Hero visual: scatter (latency x cost) + spotlight dot for recommended config. Add tiny fallback table for email.
leo-design: Visuals will follow condensed brand tokens. Microtile layout consistent: stat top, sparkline, one-line caption. Produce mobile stacked variant.
maria-ops: Localization: JP/KO/EN strings, hero <80 chars for JP/KR. I'll run legal check after v1.
figma-bot: New file: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/serving-wins-benchcards (comments enabled)
sophia-marketing: Accessibility: alt text for each image, longdesc link to slide deck, caption strings for screenreaders.
leo-design: Timeline: v1 sketch EOD Thursday, final exports Monday morning. I'll include a token sheet and export naming guidance.
sophia-marketing: Priority: legibility at email-thumb size. If needed, remove decorative elements first.
jen-product: Keep copy plain language; avoid jargon in microtile captions.
leo-design: Uploading v1 now. Will add review checklist in figma and attach CSV sample metrics.
maria-ops: After v1 I'll queue JP/KR localization and tag legal.
sophia-marketing: Thanks — tag me on Figma for any copy decisions. (reacted with :thumbsup:)
